type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {l : ℕ} (E : Fin l → Fin l → σ →₀ ℕ)
  (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  (∀ (j : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    ∀ {B : ℝ},
      0 ≤ B →
        (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
          ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ),
            |↑((Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv (E μ ν)) P).det.coeff d)| ≤
              (∏ j, (↑(r j) + 1)) ^ l * ↑l.factorial * B ^ l * 2 ^ ((∑ j, r j) * l)
what: Every coefficient of an l×l determinant of arbitrary Hasse derivatives of P is bounded by N^l*l!*B^l*2^(S*l), N=∏(rj+1), S=∑rj.
how: Coefficient ≤ coefficient length; support length ≤ box cardinality times B; each Hasse derivative length grows by at most2^S; expand determinant into l! products; scalar ring normalization.
hypotheses: Arbitrary finite variable type, natural matrix size including0, arbitrary derivative-index array and exponent; degree and coefficient bounds; explicit hB0 is redundant.
caller_summary: One explicit use in Roth.index_det_le at Theta.lean475; canonical293 audit confirms sole direct consumer. Entire caller recompiled through strongest generic specialization.
mathlib_api_audit: Matrix.det_le requires multiplicative AbsoluteValue; coefficient length is submultiplicative RingSeminorm. Polynomial.hasseDeriv_coeff is univariate. Finsupp and Finset size inequalities supply steps, not a≤3-call replacement.
moral_duplications: A Hasse-specific assembly of support-cardinality, derivative-length and determinant seminorm estimates. Prior accepted project assessments do not make these existing mathlib lemmas.
generalization: Verified RingSeminorm over arbitrary CommRing, normalized at1, arbitrary finite matrix index; omit hB0.
missing_api: Coefficient l1 size API for multivariate polynomials, its Hasse estimate, and normalized RingSeminorm determinant estimate. Pinned Polynomial/Norm TODO documents missing lp norm API.
junk: Sound, used main-result lemma with nonempty and empty determinant cases; no junk finding.
action: YES-but-generalise-first; upstream generalized norm/Hasse infrastructure and coefficient bound, update sole caller to omit hB0.
